mechanics.claim: The mixed damage is applied as two separate instances, magic first then physical, within the same game tick, and if the magic damage kills the unit the physical damage is not dealt (a bug).
mechanics.quote: The mixed damage is applied in two instances, and the {{as|magic damage}} will be dealt first within the same game tick.

mechanics.claim: Marked enemies not within the area at the time of the gust are not affected by the second (damage) portion.
mechanics.quote: ''Marked'' enemies that are not within the area will not be affected by the second portion of the ability.

mechanics.claim: Yone blinks behind the last champion hit (or to max range) shortly after the cast time, before the damage gust occurs.
mechanics.quote: '''Yone''' will {{tip|blink}} after a {{fd|0.05}}-second delay of the cast time being completed.

mechanics.claim: Against a spell shield, Yone still blinks to the last champion hit even though the shield blocks the effects on that target.
mechanics.quote: When striking against {{tip|spell shield}}, '''Yone''' will still {{tip|blink}} to the last champion hit even if they block the effects to themselves.

mechanics.claim: The knock up begins only once the pull (movement toward Yone) ends.
mechanics.quote: The {{tip|airborne|knock up}} starts once the pull ends.
